sections.title: AI Agent Applications for San Francisco Organizations
sections.description: Production AI agent solutions for SF's world-leading organizations.

blocks.heading: FinTech Regulatory and Compliance Agents
paragraphs: For Stripe, Brex, Plaid, and SF's world-leading FinTech community:

Multi-jurisdiction regulatory monitoring agents: Autonomous agents tracking CFPB rulemaking, FinCEN guidance, SEC payment-related releases, and state money transmitter regulation changes — synthesizing regulatory developments into structured compliance action items for Stripe's and Brex's compliance teams navigating 50-state licensing requirements and federal oversight simultaneously. Agents monitor regulatory RSS feeds, agency websites, and federal register publications continuously, generating alerts when relevant rules change.

KYC and due diligence agents: Autonomous agents gathering and verifying business information for Stripe's and Brex's merchant and business customer onboarding — querying business registration databases, sanctions lists (OFAC), adverse media, and beneficial ownership registries to assemble KYC packages for compliance review.

Dispute resolution agents: Autonomous chargeback management agents processing incoming dispute evidence, matching to transaction records, preparing response packages, and tracking deadlines for SF's large payment processor community.
Cost: $60,000–$165,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | FinCEN, CFPB, CCPA

blocks.heading: Biotech Research Agents
paragraphs: For Genentech (South San Francisco HQ), Gilead Sciences (Foster City), and the Bay Area's exceptional biotech research community:

Drug discovery literature mining agents: Autonomous agents monitoring PubMed, bioRxiv, and patent databases for publications relevant to Genentech's drug discovery programs — classifying by relevance to specific targets, extracting key findings, and assembling daily research summaries that keep scientists current without manual literature review.

Competitive intelligence agents: Autonomous agents tracking competitor clinical trial registrations, FDA regulatory submissions, and patent filings for Bay Area biotech companies' business intelligence programs.

Adverse event monitoring agents: Autonomous agents scanning medical literature and FDA's FAERS (adverse event reporting system) for safety signals relevant to Bay Area biotech's marketed and pipeline drugs.
Default deployment: self-hosted Llama 3 — research IP never leaves corporate infrastructure.
Cost: $60,000–$165,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks | Self-hosted, research IP protection

blocks.heading: Enterprise Knowledge and Workflow Agents
paragraphs: For Salesforce, Dropbox, and SF's large enterprise technology employers:

Salesforce CRM intelligence agents: Autonomous agents monitoring Salesforce data for account health signals — declining usage, billing changes, support escalations — and generating proactive outreach recommendations for customer success and account management teams.

Content and asset management agents: Autonomous agents organizing, tagging, and maintaining Dropbox's large enterprise content repositories — automated metadata extraction, duplicate detection, and retention policy enforcement for enterprise content management.

Meeting intelligence agents: Autonomous agents processing meeting transcripts and action items for SF's technology companies — extracting commitments, tracking follow-through, and escalating missed deadlines.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | CCPA, SSO integration

blocks.heading: CCPA Compliance Agents
paragraphs: For SF's consumer technology companies managing California privacy obligations:

Data subject request agents: Autonomous agents processing consumer right-to-know, right-to-delete, and opt-out requests under CCPA/CPRA — validating request identity, locating responsive data across systems, and generating compliant responses within California's 45-day response window.

Vendor compliance monitoring agents: Autonomous agents monitoring third-party data processor compliance with CCPA's service provider requirements — verifying that vendor agreements include required CCPA contractual terms and that data processing practices remain consistent with service provider limitations.
Cost: $50,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks | CCPA/CPRA compliance

sections.title: San Francisco AI Agent Standards
sections.description: Observable, interruptible, and documented — the Bay Area's technical bar for production AI agents.

blocks.heading: Observable and auditable
paragraphs: SF's technically sophisticated clients require agent observability — comprehensive logging of every agent action, tool call, and decision for audit and debugging. ClickMasters builds all SF agents with LangSmith or equivalent observability from the first deployment.

blocks.heading: Human-in-the-loop design
paragraphs: SF's AI safety culture creates strong client expectations for human oversight of high-stakes agent decisions. ClickMasters designs SF agents with explicit human approval gates for consequential actions — regulatory submissions, customer communications, financial transactions — rather than fully autonomous execution.

blocks.heading: CCPA-compliant data handling
paragraphs: Agents processing California consumer data must comply with CCPA — ClickMasters designs all SF consumer-facing agents with CCPA data minimization, purpose limitation, and consumer rights infrastructure.
